_comment: Maya's content plan — the spine of the Maya->Reed pull loop. Maya (the content DIRECTOR) reads this plan + her recent output, then emits concrete IMAGE REQUESTS (briefs) to Reed via maya-plan.js. This closes the loop: Reed used to PUSH images that Maya only captioned; now Maya PULLS the images she actually needs for the plan. Pillars + cadence are a Basic Reflex seed — Paul edits this file, Maya obeys it.
status: seed — Paul to confirm pillars + cadence
voice: warm, enthusiastic, genuine, celebrates members, never salesy. 'Coach Paul' to the public, never 'Reed'. Under 200 words, mobile-first, hook in the first line.
bridge_test: Would a member send this to a friend?
Could it be shot on a phone?
Does the moment belong to the member, not the camera?

cadence.note: 5-7 posts/week, member-spotlight dominant. One reel anchor per week ('Maya Asks Coach Paul'). Internal Game ~20% of mix sourced from the Screening Room. Reels under 15s, hook in first 1.5s, member voiceover audio over trending audio.

pillars.name: Member Celebration
pillars.description: Real members, real milestones. First jab, first sparring round, 5lb PR, showing up after a long week. Make the small thing feel big. The member is the story, never the prop. 'The Bell Rings for Everyone' lives here.
pillars.example_post_type: Member spotlight reel or carousel — a member mid-moment, caption that names the win without making them perform it

pillars.name: Technique
pillars.description: The 6 punches, the defense, footwork — Coach Paul's substance. Basics-are-everything. Cuban 'learn to see, not just to fight'. Tack-sharp, real gym light, no stock-photo flatness.
pillars.example_post_type: Technique scroll / close-up still of a punch or guard, demonstrated cleanly, with a one-line coaching truth

pillars.name: Internal Game
pillars.description: Mindset, fear, the inner work — sourced from the Screening Room. Boxing principles that build lives, not just fighters. The bag doesn't lie. The quiet, true stuff that makes BR a home, not a fitness chain.
pillars.example_post_type: Quote-over-image or atmospheric still — a screening-room idea turned into one honest line about the internal game

pillars.name: Maya Asks Coach Paul
pillars.description: Weekly reel anchor. Maya poses a real member question; Coach Paul answers on camera, patient and present. Miyagi substance, Brady energy. The signature recurring format.
pillars.example_post_type: Reel — Coach Paul mid-answer in the gym, question as text overlay, member voiceover or his own voice

pillars.name: Motivation / Mindset
pillars.description: Energy and momentum without the salesy fitness-template cliches. Never 'crushing it' / 'beast mode' / 'no excuses'. Sounds like BR — warm, gritty, for everyone. Make the quiet person feel included.
pillars.example_post_type: Atmospheric gym still or short loop — a line that lands like a friend talking, not a billboard
